title: Treasuries Rally as Soft Jobs Data Trims Fed Rate-Hike Bets
summary: US Treasuries rallied after data showed employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July, suggesting labor market challenges that could impact the Federal Reserve’s willingness to raise interest rates.

title: BlackRock's Rick Rieder Sees Rate Hike Unlikely
summary: Rick Rieder, BlackRock's Chief Investment Officer of Global Fixed Income, discussed the Federal Reserve's monetary policy outlook, emphasizing that a rate hike currently does not make much sense given recent economic data.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hungary Warns of Dramatic Hit From Drought, Nuclear Outage

title: BlackRock's Rieder on Jobs Report, Fed Rates and Bonds
summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, reacts to the July US employment report, calling it "unremarkable," and says the economy is going through a "productivity revolution." Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Rieder also discusses the outlook for Federal Reserve monetary policy and how the company is currently investing in the fixed income market. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cyclospora Outbreak Sends Shivers Through Restaurant Stocks
summary: The cyclospora outbreak in the US tied to lettuce used in restaurants has made more than 10,000 people sick according to the Centers for Disease Control. This has caused fewer people to go out to eat or get fast food. Now this is starting to hurt the restaurant sector. R.J. Hottovy of Placer.AI research covers the space and joins "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks and Bonds Rise as Jobs Ease Fed-Hike Worry: Markets Wrap
summary: A sharp slowdown in the US jobs market drove stocks higher while bond yields fell on speculation the Federal Reserve won’t be forced to raise interest rates any time soon.

title: US Stocks Jump as July Jobs Report May Ease Rate Hike Pressures
summary: US stocks were higher on Friday after jobs data showed the US economy unexpectedly shed jobs in July, which could prompt the Federal Reserve to delay interest-rate increases.

title: Zimbabwe’s VFEX Plans $5 Billion Market Value, Venture Board for Mining
summary: Zimbabwe’s dollar-denominated stock exchange plans to boost its market value by 25% over the next year after Old Mutual Ltd. joined the bourse, while rolling out new products including a venture board that will help junior mining and exploration companies raise capital.

title: JBS Shares Surge After $2.5 Billion Deal With Indonesia Fund
summary: JBS NV shares climbed after the company said the Indonesian sovereign wealth fund Danantara agreed to invest $2.5 billion to form a joint venture that will focus on the protein market in Southeast Asia, Australia and New Zealand.

title: AIG Profit Beat Estimates, Cites Strong Underwriting
summary: American International Group Inc. reported second-quarter results that surpassed Wall Street expectations, roughly two months after Eric Andersen took over as chief executive officer.

title: Puerto Rico’s Capital Sees Blowout Demand for Rare Muni Sale

title: BlackRock Is Being as Boring as Possible in Bonds, Rieder Says
summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, discusses how the company is currently investing in the fixed income market on "Bloomberg The Open." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Rate Hike Doesn't Make Sense Right Now, BlackRock's Rieder Says
summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, says the July US employment report most likely takes a Federal Reserve rate hike off the table. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Open," Rieder says a rate cut is still possible this year. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Big Tech Stocks Storm Back as AI Fears Fade and Euphoria Resumes
summary: After spending much of the year in the stock market doghouse over fears about their profligate spending on artificial intelligence, the world’s biggest technology companies are suddenly leading the way once again.

title: BlackRock's Rieder Sees 'Productivity Revolution' in US
summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, calls the July US employment report "unremarkable." Speaking on "Bloomberg The Open," Rieder says he expects 6% nominal GDP amid a "productivity revolution" in the US. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Airbnb Jumps After Raising Its 2026 Revenue Outlook Again
summary: Airbnb Inc. shares jumped by the most in 16 months after the company boosted its annual revenue forecast for a second time this year, citing robust demand in the US and Europe.

title: Gold Jumps as Weak US Jobs Data Adds Fuel to Bullion’s Rebound
summary: Gold jumped more than 3% after an unexpected contraction in the US jobs market, extending a rebound from its slump below $4,000 an ounce.

title: US Loses 23,000 Jobs in July, Unemployment Rate Falls
summary: US employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July and hiring over the previous two months was revised lower. 23,000 jobs were lost, the estimate was for a gain of 80,000 jobs. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1% from 4.2%. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jobs Revisions Are Pointing to Labor Weakness, Says BlackRock’s Rosenberg
summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the Systematic Multi-Strategy Fund at BlackRock, explains why he would be “hesitant’ to write off the July US jobs report which saw payrolls decline by 23,000 while the unemployment rate fell to 4.1%. Rosenberg says he sees the headline number as “a bit confusing.” (Source: Bloomberg)
